name: GEOGLOWS Hydrological Model v2 stream network

Changes: reaches of 1,000 km² or more upstream inside the map box, lines reversed to run downstream, joined to the attribute table on LINKNO, and an endorheic flag derived by the project.
used_in: River courses (pipeline/geoglows.py, pipeline/rivers.py; Makefile -> build/geoglows); unnamed reaches in isostyle river rules
